# London Field Atlas — Rhino mass workflow

1. Open 도시 Rhino 6/7 and download the required region ZIP(s), or download one building's .3dm from its card. The expanded city is divided into southwest, southeast, northwest (including Isokon), and northeast. All four regional files share the same city origin. To edit the full city, import all four into one Rhino document.
2. Open in Rhino 6 or 7 (also supported by Rhino 8). Downloads are saved in Rhino 6 file format. Files use metres, X east, Y north, Z up. City origin is latitude 51.51, longitude -0.106 (WGS84 local azimuthal equidistant projection).
3. Keep the origin, orientation and scale. Individual building files use a local origin at that building's anchor; the website applies that anchor automatically. Do not move a city model to a building-local origin or vice versa.
4. Models are editable meshes, not parametric NURBS/BIM. Use mesh editing tools or replace with your own geometry. For new NURBS, run Mesh and save the resulting visible mesh objects. Avoid duplicate visible surfaces and meshes.
5. Save as .3dm. In the website choose Rhino 불러오기, choose the matching target and file, check the displayed dimensions, then 지도에 적용.
6. For whole-city files preserve object names LM:<building-id>|<object-id> to preserve building selection. Other names become context. IDs: stpauls, shard, gherkin, towerbridge, tate, millennium, barbican, lloyds, westminster, abbey, museum, tower, isokon. Applying a regional file to the whole-city target replaces the displayed city with that region. Merge all wanted regions first. A merged full city is about 119 MB before mesh reduction, so use ReduceMesh or work on one landmark to fit the 100 MB browser limit.
7. Files remain in this browser's IndexedDB only. Clearing browser data removes them. Keep your own .3dm backup. Original restore affects the selected target only.

One unit = 1 metre. Automatic metre/mm/cm/feet/inch units are supported. Override if necessary. Models are not normalized or automatically resized. Maximum upload: 100 MB and 3 million triangles, extent 25 km.

Data: © OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright, ODbL 1.0. Central snapshot 2026-09-21, north/west extension 2026-09-30. 67,215 masses over 6.84 x 7.12 km. Footprints and coordinates are geographic data; height values include 4,330 recorded heights, 25,067 estimates of 3.2 m per floor and 37,818 12 m fallbacks. Isokon uses its OSM footprint and a 12 m assumed height; galleries, balconies and upper setbacks are simplified. Terrain is flat; roofs and landmark forms are approximations. OSM-derived data are supplied in assets/city-data.zip (full dataset) and assets/city.json (streaming manifest) plus assets/tiles/ under ODbL. Regional Rhino geometry uses the full-resolution footprints, not the generalized overview.
